mathematics.assertion_tested: Unchanged 38-entry catalogue and all 2432 integer terms; exact Python/browser generator agreement through n=63; existing reciprocal, counting and transform oracles retained; six-row reading maps for every entry preserve n and value, map reciprocal n to ordinary degree N*n and coefficient a(n)/(N*n)!, map signed Euler n to Euler index 2n without extra scaling, and leave direct sequence indices unchanged. mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact integers and rational values; plot coordinates approximate
mathematics.conventions: Compressed index starts at zero; reciprocal ordinary degree N*n; least nonnegative residues; second differences undefined before index two; adjacent-residue points need the next integer-valued sample; query signs retained. Discovery matches every usable transformed input term, at least six, against contiguous stored samples; multiple target positions are grouped. Binomial transforms sum from k=0 to n; inverse sign is (-1)^(n-k). Study indices retain their original n, even for later windows. Prefix transforms start at zero; undefined initial differences and zero-denominator ratios retain their positions. Sample GCD uses defined integers only and is absent when any defined value is noninteger. Constant differences require at least four defined values and do not prove infinite polynomial identities. Connections remain directed from transformed source to raw target; incoming listings do not infer inverse operations. Index and connection exports do not change existing entry JSON or comparison criteria.
